name: Garun
source:
Great priest of  the God of Chaos.
His followers are [url=/c90002]Leah[/url] the swordswoman and Pazuzu the storm genie. Garun has also made a dark alliance  the evil priests [url=/c90007]Quack[/url] and [url=/c90010]Arachne[/url].
